The pipeline further features VLR247 and VLR258. Engineers developed these specific ActRII-Fc ligand traps to spare the BMP-9 and BMP-10 ligands, which researchers have previously linked to adverse hematologic events.

Additionally, the portfolio incorporates VLR360, an anti-PDGF-B monoclonal antibody addressing an alternative pathway involved in pulmonary arterial hypertension. Developers constructed VLR360 and the ActRII-Fcs for use as monotherapies or in combination.
Strengthening Executive Leadership
Concurrently, Paragon announced the addition of former senior executives from
Apogee Therapeutics

to its leadership roster. This seasoned team will direct the clinical advancement of Paragon’s proprietary assets and drive the formation of new ventures, beginning their focused efforts with the newly acquired Velaris.
The team previously worked together at Apogee, where they helped advance five Paragon-discovered assets into clinical development until Apogee’s 2026 acquisition by
